authority: User directed completion/testing of the recurrent sampler despite its latency miss, and asked whether other useful prototypes were abandoned for missing targets.
current_priority: Finish the trained recurrent sampler's complete physical, own-history, independent-scene and matched application evaluation before another architecture.
target_qualification: Keep the 1.2 ms maximum per generated step and 1e-5 worst equation/pressure/velocity/tracer criteria, all four horizons, and ordered later-phase gates unchanged.
practical_value: Record baseline-relative speed, complete physical accuracy, drift, setup and scope separately from target qualification. A target miss is not by itself evidence that the candidate is useless.
triage: A plausible meaningful advantage over Rheon supports a bounded completion experiment even when the final speed target is missed. Retain numerical equivalence, managed CUDA training, exact CPU restoration and independent verification. Severe accuracy failures require diagnosis rather than an unsupported usefulness claim.

historical_examples.assessment: Completed trained and independently tested baselines; approximately 89-105 ms per 32-cubed step for primary seeds. Not lost untrained candidates. Current recurrent sampler improves both speed and accuracy.

Useful near misses were subsequently optimized. A related model improved from 2.39 to 1.85 ms per step on the heterogeneous small-grid mix while retaining approximately 0.0034 worst own240 error. These are not 32-cubed timings.

All six were trained, restored, timed and tested through240. Their roughly 11-20 ms per 32-cubed step came with equation errors near or above1. Further fitting/design is needed before they can be called practical alternatives.

Initial variants failed numerical equivalence despite meeting the looser physical target. They were retained and repaired; the precise routed successor independently confirmed 2.133 ms/4.6963e-4 on the small-grid pressure-only benchmark. Its scope and cold/memory limits differ from a complete generator.
